thread:
maya: Quick check — KMS/HSM milestone status. We need clear owners for the keystore shim + attestation pipeline pieces before EOD Friday. Who can own staging smoke and the audit-log ingest validation?

dmitri: I can take the keystore shim (staging smoke). Targeting Thu EOD for a smoke run. blocked by infra NAT rule and the PR merge (repo: infra/keystore-shim PR#88).

elaine: NAT rule change is the one I flagged. I can schedule the window Tue 10:00–11:00 PST. Need confirmation on svc account and ingress IPs.

ryan: I will provision svc-attest-redwood. Which perms do you need? suggest: iam.serviceAccounts.actAs, storage.objects.get (for attestation blobs).

maya: exact list from checklist:```
- iam.serviceAccounts.actAs
- iam.roles/log.viewer
- storage.objects.get
- kms.cryptoKeyVersions.viewPublicKey
```

dmitri: thanks. Once svc account exists I can run kubectl apply -f deploy/keystore-smoke.yaml and validate keys rotate. Command I'll run:```
kubectl --context staging apply -f deploy/keystore-smoke.yaml
kubectl --context staging logs -l app=keystore -f
```

elaine: noted. I'll create the NAT change PR and tag @dmitri and @ryan for the infra window. Ops window will include a brief rollback plan. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: Scheduled maintenance: NAT rule update on Tue 10:00 PST. Notifying infra-oncall.

maya: For audit-log ingest validation — need an owner to run a backfill test and confirm events have upstream signatures attached. Who can do the ingest side?

ryan: I can run the backfill test once keystore smoke passes. I'll kick off a small batch (5k events) to avoid spamming QA. Plan: run backfill, check signature header x-attest-signature and verify against public key.

maya: perfect. Also add a quick regression check: confirm end-to-end on a replayed trace (trace id format: trace-<env>-<id>) and ensure latency stays <250ms 95th pctl for signature verification step.

dmitri: will capture perf numbers in the smoke logs and attach gist. If we see >250ms we fall back to cached public keys for 10m TTL.

elaine: FYI security review needs the attestation design doc link and list of owners. I'll attach both after the NAT PR.

maya: owners recap: keystore shim -> dmitri, svc provisioning -> ryan, NAT infra -> elaine, ingest/backfill -> ryan. I'll update the milestone board and ping compliance for the fieldwork window. :lock:

ryan: pushing svc-attest-redwood today, will post service account email once done.

dmitri: PR#88 now has a deployment note, tagging @elaine for the window. planning smoke run Thu 17:00 PST.

maya: awesome — thanks team. If anything slips, please update the milestone card and CC compliance.

ops-bot: Reminder: maintenance window Tue 10:00 PST (NAT rule).
